title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - ProductionEquipmentFunction
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/ProductionEquipmentFunction . Functionality necessary to accomplish the task for which a production equipment is designed (e.g. a joining or cutting function). Subclass of the external saref:Function class (SAREF core); the SAREF4INMA ttl declares no own data/object property for this class, so it can be populated with further subclasses describing concrete functions depending on the use case.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ProductionEquipmentFunction'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

name.description: Property. Not a literal OWL data property of s4inma:ProductionEquipmentFunction in the ttl; added for usability as a human-readable label for the function (e.g. 'Joining function'), matching how concrete function instances are named in the ETSI TS 103 410-5 worked example (ex:JoiningFunction).
